restartBody: Units and claims stay. Initiative, HP, temp HP, conditions, defense modifiers, disabled state, HP history, round and escalation die reset.
clearBody_one: The only unit is removed and every player claim is released.
clearBody_few: All {{count}} units are removed and every player claim is released.
clearBody_many: All {{count}} units are removed and every player claim is released.
clearBody_other: All {{count}} units are removed and every player claim is released.
removeBody: The unit leaves the turn order. Undo can bring it back.
revokeBody: The current link stops working and every claim is released. Players need the new link.
stopBody: Players lose access to the combat, and their heroes are released.
deleteCombatBody_one: The combat, its unit and the player link are deleted. This can’t be undone.
deleteCombatBody_few: The combat, its {{count}} units and the player link are deleted. This can’t be undone.
deleteCombatBody_many: The combat, its {{count}} units and the player link are deleted. This can’t be undone.
deleteCombatBody_other: The combat, its {{count}} units and the player link are deleted. This can’t be undone.
deletePresetBody: The preset leaves the Library. Units already added to combats stay.
deleteAccountBody: All combats, presets and player links are deleted. This can’t be undone.
leaveBody: Your heroes are released. Open the link again to join as a new player.
